## Story Goal

Let a SUPERVISOR update **`slaDays`** (integer 1–30) and **`isActive`** on a service their department owns, through a new authenticated endpoint and a supervisor-only SPA screen. Everything else about a service (code, name, department, allowMultiple, required documents) stays read-only.

Covered:

1. `PATCH /api/v1/services/:id` with partial body `{ slaDays?, isActive? }`; validates the fields, enforces supervisor-only + department scope (BR-11, BR-18), persists the change, returns the updated service.
2. `app/api/rules/service-settings.ts` — pure `parseServiceSettings` returning validated patch or a list of invalid field names, so the HTTP layer stays thin.
3. Repository helpers `findServiceById` and `findServiceDetailById` (fetch regardless of `isActive`, needed by the supervisor UI and by later request workflows), plus `ServiceRow` interface — all contracts the context block requires.
4. Supervisor SPA page `/staff/supervisor/services` listing the department's services and inline-editing both fields.

Not in scope: editing `name`, `code`, `departmentId`, `allowMultiple`, required documents; recomputing `dueAt` on in-flight requests (PQ-07); audit log for setting changes; pagination.

## Product rules (from story)

- **BR-11:** `slaDays ∈ [1, 30]`, integer. Any other value → `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`.
- **BR-18:** A SUPERVISOR may edit services whose `departmentId === user.departmentId`. Anything else → `403 FORBIDDEN`.
- **PQ-07 (approved default):** `dueAt` is **not** recomputed; `isActive` toggles affect only new drafts and the public catalog visibility.
- **Visibility of inactive services for a supervisor:** the supervisor UI must list **all** services in their department, including inactive ones (otherwise they could never reactivate one). The public catalog (Story 03) keeps hiding inactive services.
- **Partial body:** both fields are optional; sending `{}` is a validation error (`fields: []` → one entry `"body"` to signal "no editable field provided"). Sending `{ slaDays: 5 }` alone is accepted.
- **Idempotence:** sending the current value is accepted and returns 200 with the unchanged service.

### 1 — Widen `ProblemError` to carry `fields`

**File:** `app/api/core/problem.ts`

- Add an optional `fields?: readonly string[]` constructor arg; include it in the JSON body when present. The existing login call sites keep working because `fields` is optional.

```ts
export class ProblemError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    readonly code: ProblemCode,
    readonly title: string,
    readonly fields?: readonly string[],
  ) { super(title); }
}

// in problemMiddleware(): add fields to the payload when present
const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { type: 'about:blank', title: problem.title, status: problem.status, code: problem.code };
if (problem.fields) payload.fields = problem.fields;
res.status(problem.status).type('application/problem+json').send(JSON.stringify(payload));
```

Do **not** add a new `ProblemCode`. The generic non-login title lives at the call site, per PQ-09.

### 2 — Pure rule: `parseServiceSettings`

**Create file:** `app/api/rules/service-settings.ts`

- Export `ServiceSettingsPatch` and `parseServiceSettings(body: unknown)`. Pure; no I/O.
- Rules (BR-11):
  - If `body` is not an object → `{ fields: ['body'] }`.
  - `slaDays` present → must be a finite integer in `[1, 30]`, else `fields.push('slaDays')`.
  - `isActive` present → must be a boolean, else `fields.push('isActive')`.
  - Reject unknown keys → push each unknown key into `fields`.
  - Reject empty patch (neither `slaDays` nor `isActive` present) → `fields.push('body')`.
- Return `{ ok: true, patch }` on success or `{ ok: false, fields }` on failure. The HTTP handler throws `ProblemError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'Some fields are invalid.', fields)`.

```ts
export interface ServiceSettingsPatch { slaDays?: number; isActive?: boolean }

export type ParseResult =
  | { ok: true; patch: ServiceSettingsPatch }
  | { ok: false; fields: string[] };

export function parseServiceSettings(body: unknown): ParseResult {
  if (typeof body !== 'object' || body === null || Array.isArray(body)) return { ok: false, fields: ['body'] };
  const b = body as Record<string, unknown>;
  const fields: string[] = [];
  const patch: ServiceSettingsPatch = {};
  if ('slaDays' in b) {
    const v = b.slaDays;
    if (typeof v !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(v) || v < 1 || v > 30) fields.push('slaDays');
    else patch.slaDays = v;
  }
  if ('isActive' in b) {
    const v = b.isActive;
    if (typeof v !== 'boolean') fields.push('isActive');
    else patch.isActive = v;
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(b)) if (key !== 'slaDays' && key !== 'isActive') fields.push(key);
  if (patch.slaDays === undefined && patch.isActive === undefined && fields.length === 0) fields.push('body');
  return fields.length === 0 ? { ok: true, patch } : { ok: false, fields };
}
```

Business-rule placement note: this file sits under `app/api/rules/` per the AGENTS.md convention ("BR logic lives in `api/rules` as pure functions").

### 3 — Repository additions

**File:** `app/api/modules/catalog/services.repository.ts`

- Add types and functions used by the new PATCH route and by every later story that resolves a service by id.

```ts
export interface ServiceRow {
  id: number;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  departmentId: number;
  slaDays: number;
  allowMultiple: boolean;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export function findServiceById(db: Database, id: number): ServiceRow | undefined {
  const row = db.prepare(
    `SELECT id, code, name, departmentId, slaDays, allowMultiple, isActive
       FROM service_types WHERE id = ?`,
  ).get(id) as { id: number; code: string; name: string; departmentId: number; slaDays: number; allowMultiple: number; isActive: number } | undefined;
  if (!row) return undefined;
  return { ...row, allowMultiple: row.allowMultiple === 1, isActive: row.isActive === 1 };
}

export function findServiceDetailById(db: Database, id: number): (PublicServiceDetail & { isActive: boolean }) | undefined {
  const row = findServiceById(db, id);
  if (!row) return undefined;
  const docs = db.prepare(
    `SELECT typeCode, label, mandatory FROM required_documents WHERE serviceTypeId = ? ORDER BY id`,
  ).all(row.id) as { typeCode: string; label: string; mandatory: number }[];
  return {
    code: row.code,
    name: row.name,
    departmentId: row.departmentId,
    slaDays: row.slaDays,
    allowMultiple: row.allowMultiple,
    isActive: row.isActive,
    requiredDocuments: docs.map((d) => ({ typeCode: d.typeCode, label: d.label, mandatory: d.mandatory === 1 })),
  };
}

export function listServicesByDepartment(db: Database, departmentId: number): ServiceRow[] {
  const rows = db.prepare(
    `SELECT id, code, name, departmentId, slaDays, allowMultiple, isActive
       FROM service_types WHERE departmentId = ? ORDER BY code`,
  ).all(departmentId) as { id: number; code: string; name: string; departmentId: number; slaDays: number; allowMultiple: number; isActive: number }[];
  return rows.map((r) => ({ ...r, allowMultiple: r.allowMultiple === 1, isActive: r.isActive === 1 }));
}

export function updateServiceSettings(
  db: Database,
  id: number,
  patch: { slaDays?: number; isActive?: boolean },
): void {
  const sets: string[] = [];
  const args: (number | 0 | 1)[] = [];
  if (patch.slaDays !== undefined) { sets.push('slaDays = ?'); args.push(patch.slaDays); }
  if (patch.isActive !== undefined) { sets.push('isActive = ?'); args.push(patch.isActive ? 1 : 0); }
  if (sets.length === 0) return; // defensive; handler already blocked this
  args.push(id);
  db.prepare(`UPDATE service_types SET ${sets.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`).run(...args);
}
```

### 4 — Router: `PATCH /:id` and `GET /mine`

**File:** `app/api/modules/catalog/services.routes.ts`

- Widen `ServicesDeps` to `{ db: Database; authDeps: AuthDeps }` (import `AuthDeps` from `../accounts/auth.service.js`). The public `GET /` and `GET /:code` handlers keep working unchanged — they ignore `authDeps`.
- Add `GET /mine` guarded by `requireRole(deps.authDeps, ['SUPERVISOR'])`; returns `listServicesByDepartment(db, req.user!.departmentId!)`.
- Add `PATCH /:id` guarded by `requireRole(deps.authDeps, ['SUPERVISOR'])`:

```ts
router.patch('/:id', requireRole(deps.authDeps, ['SUPERVISOR']), (req, res) => {
  const id = Number(req.params.id);
  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) throw new ProblemError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', PROBLEM_TITLES.NOT_FOUND);
  const service = findServiceById(deps.db, id);
  if (!service) throw new ProblemError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', PROBLEM_TITLES.NOT_FOUND);
  assertDepartmentScope(req.user!, service.departmentId); // BR-18 → 403
  const parsed = parseServiceSettings(req.body);
  if (!parsed.ok) throw new ProblemError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'Some fields are invalid.', parsed.fields);
  updateServiceSettings(deps.db, id, parsed.patch);
  const after = findServiceDetailById(deps.db, id)!;
  res.status(200).json(after);
});
```

- **Ordering of checks:** scope (403) is asserted **before** validation (400). This matches Story 02's note: 403 takes precedence over 404/400 to preserve BR-18. The 404 for a missing row goes first because without the row we cannot determine scope — this is acceptable since no scope leak is possible when the id does not exist.
- Keep the public `GET /` and `GET /:code` from Story 03 unchanged (they stay unauthenticated).

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **`slaDays` out of range** (0, 31, −1, 1.5, `"5"`, `NaN`) → `parseServiceSettings` pushes `'slaDays'`; handler returns `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `fields: ['slaDays']`. Covered in `rules/service-settings.test.ts`.
- **`isActive` non-boolean** (`"true"`, `1`, `null`) → `fields: ['isActive']`.
- **Unknown keys** (`{ name: 'X' }`, `{ departmentId: 2 }`, `{ slaDays: 5, foo: 1 }`) → each unknown key goes into `fields`; valid fields in the same body are rejected (atomic validation). Marker **BR-11**.
- **Empty body** (`{}`, missing body entirely) → `fields: ['body']`.
- **Non-object body** (`"hi"`, `[1]`, `null`) → `fields: ['body']`.
- **Service id not an integer** (`/api/v1/services/abc`) → `404 NOT_FOUND` (no leak of validation internals).
- **Service id valid shape, no such row** → `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- **SUPERVISOR editing a service in a different department** → `assertDepartmentScope` throws `403 FORBIDDEN`. Covered by inserting a dept-2 SUPERVISOR in the test; the seed only has one SUPERVISOR, in dept 1.
- **REVIEWER or APPLICANT attempting PATCH** → `requireRole` returns `403 FORBIDDEN` before any body parsing.
- **No session cookie on PATCH** → `requireRole` → `resolveSession` throws `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`.
- **Toggling `isActive = false`** → row is updated; public `GET /api/v1/services` list drops the row (Story 03's `WHERE isActive = 1`); public `GET /api/v1/services/:code` returns `404 NOT_FOUND` (Story 03). The supervisor list keeps showing the row because it uses `listServicesByDepartment` (no `isActive` filter). Covered in `services.routes.test.ts` by a follow-up `GET /api/v1/services` after the PATCH.
- **Changing `slaDays` while in-flight requests exist** — PRD §04 F-16 stores `dueAt` on submit; this story must **not** touch any requests table. Documented in a comment on `updateServiceSettings`. Marker **PQ-07**.
- **Idempotent PATCH** (sending current values) → 200 with the row unchanged.
- **CHECK constraint reinforcement** — the DB keeps `CHECK (slaDays > 0)` from Story 03. If a future bug lets `slaDays = 0` through the rule layer, SQLite still rejects it; the resulting error is **not** a `ProblemError` and becomes a 500 (impossible-state invariant per the conventions block).
- **Concurrent edits** — SQLite serialises writes; last-write-wins. No optimistic locking in this story (not in AC). Document in a code comment.

## Migration / Rollback

- No new migration (next free number stays **`003`** for a later story). The schema already supports both edited columns; the DB-level `CHECK (slaDays > 0)` is intentionally wider than the app-level 1–30 so the rule stays owned by `parseServiceSettings` per AGENTS.md.
- Rollback: revert the three edited files (`services.routes.ts`, `services.repository.ts`, `app.ts`), delete `rules/service-settings.ts`, delete the SPA page and the route, and revert the `ProblemError`/`problemMiddleware` widening. No data to migrate back; `isActive` and `slaDays` values stay whatever supervisors set.
- Half-applied state: if the `fields` widening ships without the handler update, nothing breaks (optional property); if the handler ships without the widening, `fields` is dropped silently by the serialiser — tests catch this via the `problem+json` body assertions.

1. **Backend builds:** `(cd app/api && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run)` — all new tests from the Test Plan pass; Story 01–03 suites stay green.
2. **Frontend builds:** `(cd app/web && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run && npx vite build)` — new `SupervisorServicesPage.test.tsx` passes; existing suites stay green.
3. **Database:** `(cd app/api && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed)` — unchanged counts (`{ serviceTypes: 3, requiredDocuments: 6 }`).
4. **Smoke — API:**
   - `(cd app/api && npm run dev)`; log in as `khalid@khidma.test` / `Passw0rd!` via curl and capture the `khidma_session` cookie.
   - `curl -b "khidma_session=…" http://localhost:3000/api/v1/services/mine | jq` → 2 rows (SHOP-LIC, SIGN-PMT).
   - `curl -b "khidma_session=…" -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"slaDays":10}' http://localhost:3000/api/v1/services/1 | jq` → updated detail.
   - `curl -i -b "khidma_session=…" -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"slaDays":99}' http://localhost:3000/api/v1/services/1` → `400`, body `code:"VALIDATION_ERROR"`, `fields:["slaDays"]`, title `"Some fields are invalid."`.
   - `curl -i -b "khidma_session=…" -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"isActive":false}' http://localhost:3000/api/v1/services/3` → `403 FORBIDDEN`.
   - `curl -i -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"slaDays":5}' http://localhost:3000/api/v1/services/1` (no cookie) → `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`.
5. **Smoke — SPA:** `(cd app/web && npm run dev)`; log in as Khalid, navigate to `/staff/supervisor` → "Service settings" link → `/staff/supervisor/services`. Edit SHOP-LIC's `slaDays` to `7`, click Save, confirm the value refreshes. Toggle `SIGN-PMT` to inactive; open an incognito window and verify `/catalog` no longer shows it; `/catalog/SIGN-PMT` shows `"Service not found."` (Story 03 path).
6. **Regression:** signed-in APPLICANT visiting `/staff/supervisor/services` → redirected to `/applicant` (Story 02 behaviour). `GET /api/v1/auth/me` and `/api/v1/services` continue to work as before.

## Done Criteria

- [ ] `app/api/rules/service-settings.ts` exports a pure `parseServiceSettings` enforcing BR-11 (`slaDays` integer 1–30, `isActive` boolean, no unknown fields, non-empty patch).
- [ ] `app/api/modules/catalog/services.repository.ts` exports `ServiceRow`, `findServiceById`, `findServiceDetailById`, `listServicesByDepartment`, and `updateServiceSettings` with the signatures above.
- [ ] `PATCH /api/v1/services/:id` is mounted inside the Story-03 `servicesRouter`, guarded by `requireRole([...])` for SUPERVISOR, enforces `assertDepartmentScope`, validates the body, persists the change, and returns the updated detail.
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/services/mine` returns the signed-in SUPERVISOR's department services, including inactive ones.
- [ ] `ProblemError` carries an optional `fields` array; `problemMiddleware()` includes it in the problem+json body when present; the login `VALIDATION_ERROR` body is unchanged (no `fields` key).
- [ ] 401 / 403 / 404 / 400 behaviour matches the matrix in **## Edge Cases & Failure Modes**; scope error takes precedence over validation; unknown numeric id → 404.
- [ ] `/staff/supervisor/services` SPA page lets a SUPERVISOR edit `slaDays` and toggle `isActive`, is wrapped by `<RequireRole roles={['SUPERVISOR']}>`, and surfaces `fields` from validation errors inline.
- [ ] In-flight requests are **not** touched; no code path in this story reads or writes any requests table (PQ-07).
- [ ] Backend + frontend test suites pass under 1 minute; Story 01–03 tests still pass.
